name: DiffViewer
whenToUse: Reviewing a change before applying it: config, a template, a policy, a file restored from backup.
Showing what an automated change did (an update, a migration) so people can trust it.

whenNotToUse.text: Comparing structured records field by field
whenNotToUse.instead: DescriptionList or a table with old / new columns

anatomy.description: filename (old → new when renamed), +/− stats, view switch and `actions`.
added / removed / unchanged with line numbers; changed words get a stronger highlight (`wordDiff`).
a row standing in for hidden unchanged lines; `context` sets how many stay visible around each change.
shown when both texts are identical.

do.caption: The change is visible at a glance, with the exact word highlighted.

dont.caption: Two blocks side by side make people hunt for the difference.

a11y: Added and removed lines carry “Added:” / “Removed:” for screen readers; + and − signs back up the color.
The diff is a named, focusable region — set `label` when there are several on a page.
Expanders are buttons that say how many lines they reveal.
The view switch is a named toggle group. Unified is the default: split needs width and reads poorly on narrow screens.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra header content (e.g. a copy or "apply" button), placed at the end.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change; longer runs collapse. `Infinity` never collapses.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when both texts are identical.

props.name: filename
props.description: New file name, shown mono in the header.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrollable diff region. Defaults to the filename.

props.name: language
props.description: Language hint shown as a tag in the header (no highlighting applied).

props.name: oldFilename
props.description: Previous file name — when it differs from `filename` the header shows a rename (old → new).

props.name: stats
props.description: Shows the +added −removed counter in the header.

props.name: viewToggle
props.description: Renders a Unified/Split switch in the header.

props.name: wordDiff
props.description: Highlights changed words inside paired lines.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally. Defaults to true in split view.
